# SCR-142 Owner home and to-do

[한국어](SCR-142.ko.md)

Path: `/`; `?view=todo` opens the full to-do. Flows: FL-001, FL-002, FL-003, FL-006, FL-007, FL-008, FL-011.

Purpose: The owner sees a morning report, acts on up to five selected items, and can open the full to-do or all projects (SPEC-042).

## Data

| Data | Source |
| --- | --- |
| Header: "My turn N", the number of to-do entries | API-263 |
| Header: the project menu | API-262 |
| To-do entries per project: diagrams to confirm, AI proposals to answer, agent questions, confirmations lifted by a new drawing | API-263 |
| The warning of a failed daily backup | API-263 |
| The projects, when there is nothing to do | API-262 |

## Actions

| Action | Operation | Result | Failure |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Open an entry | - | The stage workbench opens at the diagram, element or thread (SCR-145 with ?d= or ?thread=) | The entry was answered or removed meanwhile → the workbench shows that it is gone |
| Open a project (empty state) | - | The project page opens (SCR-144) | The project was deleted meanwhile → SCR-144 shows it is gone with a link to the projects |

## States

| State | What the owner sees and can do | From responses |
| --- | --- | --- |
| SCR-142#normal | The morning report shows at most five owner items, prioritizing questions and proposals on diagrams awaiting confirmation and then ordering by age. Cards offer reply and proposal decisions, or a confirmation result preview and another question. The full to-do at ?view=todo is oldest first; the header links to all projects. Label capped counts, failed reads and old data, and keep the backup warning. On a phone the same structure folds into one column. | API-262#200, API-263#200 |
| SCR-142#loading | Grey rows in the list's places, two per project group; no buttons. | - |
| SCR-142#empty | "Nothing waits for you" and the project list (SPEC-042). With no project yet: "A project appears here when an agent sends it for the first time", and a link to the agent credentials on SCR-143. | API-262#200, API-263#200 |
| SCR-142#error | "Something went wrong. Try again." with a retry and the request's traceId; the header still works. | API-262#default, API-263#default |
| SCR-142#permission | 401: the gate, then back here. 403: only "Only the owner of this NEXUS can open it". | API-262#401, API-262#403, API-263#401, API-263#403 |
| SCR-142#stale | "Read at 10:42" beside the title; the list reads again when the tab comes back into view. A failed refresh keeps the previous counts or list marked as old with a retry; an initial failure never displays zero. An entry answered meanwhile opens to its new state on SCR-145. | - |

## Kinds of cases

| Kind | What the screen shows |
| --- | --- |
| Access | permission state |
| Target | an entry gone meanwhile opens to "no longer in NEXUS" on SCR-145 |
| Outside services | a failed backup is a warning on top; the list still works |
| Empty and streamed answers | empty state; there are no streamed answers |
| Screen states | every state at 360 and 1440 pixels |

Wireframes: the SCR-142 frames of [wireframes.html](wireframes.html).

Mockup (stage 09): [the combined direction](../09-mockup/nexus-combination.html) shows the normal path at responsive widths. Other states and themes still need the new direction; the [earlier mockup](../../design/mockup/nexus-mockup.html) remains historical.

## Item 240: morning report

The home shows up to five owner to-do cards. Questions and proposals on diagrams awaiting confirmation come first; within each priority group the oldest comes first. The full to-do is an inbox in oldest-first order. A header link opens all projects. Cards offer the actions and information needed to reply or decide; confirmation opens a result preview and asks again. A reply or proposal decision waits ten seconds with Undo, as specified in SCR-145. The existing backup warning, unavailable and stale states remain visible.

A card that lacks question text or a proposal summary does not offer a decision without context; it links to the diagram to inspect the full content instead.

# SCR-143 Projects

[한국어](SCR-143.ko.md)

Path: `/p`. Flows: FL-001, FL-002, FL-009, FL-010.

Purpose: The owner sees every project space with its progress and opens one, and issues and revokes agent credentials (SPEC-049, SPEC-050).

## Data

| Data | Source |
| --- | --- |
| Header: "My turn N", the number of to-do entries | API-263 |
| Header: the project menu | API-262 |
| Project spaces: title, last revision and send time, stages passed out of 13, the to-do count | API-262 |
| Agent credentials: name, issued, last used, revoked | API-279 |

## Actions

| Action | Operation | Result | Failure |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Open a project | - | SCR-144 opens | Gone meanwhile → SCR-144 shows it is gone |
| Issue a credential with a name | API-280 | The secret shows once, with a copy button and the hub command to set it (secret state) | Empty or over 64 characters, or a name in use → the message by the name, kept |
| Revoke a credential | API-281 | After one question, the row shows "revoked" with the time; its next request is refused | Gone meanwhile → "not in NEXUS" and the list read again |

## States

| State | What the owner sees and can do | From responses |
| --- | --- | --- |
| SCR-143#normal | Projects as rows, newest send first, each with "N of 13 stages passed" and its to-do count; a row opens SCR-144, which has each stage's state and the tool links. Under them the credentials table with a revoke button per row and an issue form. After a deletion on SCR-144, "Deleted demo" shows on top once. On a phone: projects and credentials read-only; issue and revoke are not offered, with "Do this on a PC". | API-262#200, API-263#200, API-279#200, API-280#200, API-281#200 |
| SCR-143#loading | Grey rows for projects and credentials in their places; the issue form is off. | - |
| SCR-143#empty | No project: "A project appears here when an agent sends it for the first time: issue a credential below, set it in the hub and push with --first." No credential: "No agent can send yet." | API-262#200, API-279#200 |
| SCR-143#error | A failed read: a message and a retry per table, so the other table still shows. A refused issue: the message by the name field, the name kept. | API-262#default, API-263#default, API-279#default, API-280#400, API-280#409, API-280#413, API-280#415, API-280#default, API-281#400, API-281#404, API-281#409, API-281#413, API-281#415, API-281#default |
| SCR-143#permission | 401: the gate, then back here. 403: only the not-owner message; cross-site: a reload. | API-262#401, API-262#403, API-263#401, API-263#403, API-279#401, API-279#403, API-280#401, API-280#403, API-281#401, API-281#403 |
| SCR-143#stale | "Read at 10:42"; read again when the tab comes back into view. | - |
| SCR-143#secret | The new credential's secret in a box with a copy button, "It shows only now", and `corthex-hub` setup words. Leaving or reloading the page hides it for good (SPEC-049). A phone never shows it, since issuing is on a PC; its 360-pixel frame is a narrow PC window. | API-280#201 |

## Kinds of cases

| Kind | What the screen shows |
| --- | --- |
| Access | permission state |
| Input | the name's message by the field, the name kept |
| Repeats | issue and revoke are off while they run; a repeated issue shows the same credential without its secret |
| Data exposure | the secret shows once and is never loaded again |
| Screen states | every state at 360 and 1440 pixels |

Wireframes: the SCR-143 frames of [wireframes.html](wireframes.html).

Mockup (stage 09): the SCR-143 screen of [nexus-mockup.html](../../design/mockup/nexus-mockup.html), every state at 360 and 1440 pixels in the light and dark themes. Open the file in a browser; an address such as `#SCR-143/normal/1440/light` picks the screen, state, width and theme.

# SCR-144 Project

[한국어](SCR-144.ko.md)

Path: `/p/{project}`. Flows: FL-002, FL-006, FL-010, FL-013.

Purpose: The owner sees one project's 13 stages per part with their state and last checkpoint, links Notion and Jira, and deletes the space at #data (SPEC-013, SPEC-035, SPEC-046, SPEC-047).

## Data

| Data | Source |
| --- | --- |
| The project's questions and items to review, with target links | API-263 |
| Header: "My turn N", the number of to-do entries | API-263 |
| Header: the project menu | API-262 |
| Parts and their stages: state, date of the last checkpoint, "changed since the pass" | API-264 |
| Tool links of the project and its stages, with the status last read and its time | API-264 |
| What deleting the space removes, with counts (#data) | API-277 |

## Actions

| Action | Operation | Result | Failure |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Open a stage | - | SCR-145 opens at that part and stage | Nothing sent for it → SCR-145's empty state |
| Link a Notion page or a Jira project to the project or a stage | API-282 | The link shows with "not read yet" until NEXUS reads it | Not a Notion or Jira address → the message by the address, kept; the same link → no second link |
| Remove a tool link | API-283 | The link is gone | Already removed (404 tool-link-not-found) → the link is gone from the list, as when it works |
| Delete the project space | API-277, API-278 | After the owner types the project's name and confirms, the space is removed and the projects list opens with "Deleted demo" | Gone already → the error state: "This project is not in NEXUS" with the link to the projects; the owner does not confirm → nothing removed |

## States

| State | What the owner sees and can do | From responses |
| --- | --- | --- |
| SCR-144#normal | Before the stages, show this project's questions first and then items to review, each opening its target thread or diagram; a to-do read failure is reported separately. For each part, initially collapse the stages into “Decide what to make” (01–04), “Decide how to make it” (05–09), and “Build and check” (10–13); opening a group reveals its original stage rows and status. Each stage link starts with a plain-language purpose and retains the familiar stage name in parentheses. The stages grouped by part, 13 per part (a project without parts is one group), as rows with a state tag, the date of the last checkpoint and its links; a passed stage whose confirmation was lifted says "changed since the pass" (SPEC-035). Tool links show their status and the time it was read, or "not read yet". On a phone: stages and links read-only; linking, removing links and deleting are not offered, with "Do this on a PC". | API-262#200, API-263#200, API-264#200, API-278#200, API-282#201, API-282#200, API-283#200, API-283#404 (tool-link-not-found) |
| SCR-144#loading | Thirteen grey rows per part in the stage list's places; the #data section's counts are grey. | - |
| SCR-144#empty | A space with nothing drawn yet: every stage says "Nothing sent yet". | API-264#200 |
| SCR-144#error | 404: "This project is not in NEXUS" and a link to the projects. Others: a message and a retry. A refused link: the message by the address, kept. | API-262#default, API-263#default, API-264#404, API-264#default, API-277#404, API-277#default, API-278#400, API-278#404, API-278#409, API-278#413, API-278#415, API-278#default, API-282#400, API-282#404, API-282#409, API-282#413, API-282#415, API-282#default, API-283#400, API-283#404 (project-not-found), API-283#409, API-283#default |
| SCR-144#permission | 401: the gate, then back here. 403: only the not-owner message; cross-site: a reload. | API-262#401, API-262#403, API-263#401, API-263#403, API-264#401, API-264#403, API-277#401, API-277#403, API-278#401, API-278#403, API-282#401, API-282#403, API-283#401, API-283#403 |
| SCR-144#stale | "Read at 10:42"; read again when the tab comes back into view. A failed to-do refresh keeps the previous tasks marked as old with a retry; open stage groups remain open across redraws. | - |
| SCR-144#delete | At #data: the counts of snapshots, diagrams, comments, confirmations and layouts that go, a field for the project's name and a delete button that turns on when the name matches. After the delete, the projects list opens. Deleting is on a PC; the 360-pixel frame is a narrow PC window. | API-277#200 |

## Kinds of cases

| Kind | What the screen shows |
| --- | --- |
| Access | permission state |
| Input | the address's message by the field, kept |
| Target | 404: the project is gone, with a link to the projects |
| Repeats | delete is off while it runs; a link added twice is one link |
| Outside services | a tool that cannot be read keeps its last status and time (SPEC-046) |
| Screen states | every state at 360 and 1440 pixels |

Wireframes: the SCR-144 frames of [wireframes.html](wireframes.html).

Mockup (stage 09): the SCR-144 screen of [nexus-mockup.html](../../design/mockup/nexus-mockup.html), every state at 360 and 1440 pixels in the light and dark themes. Open the file in a browser; an address such as `#SCR-144/normal/1440/light` picks the screen, state, width and theme.

# SCR-145 Stage workbench

[한국어](SCR-145.ko.md)

Path: `/p/{project}/{part}/{stage}`, with the optional query `?d={diagram}`. Flows: FL-001, FL-002, FL-003, FL-004, FL-005, FL-006, FL-007, FL-008, FL-012, FL-013.

Purpose: The owner reads a stage's diagram or item table and works on it: moves, comments, answers AI proposals, renames and connects, and confirms; on stage 01 during a workshop, edits sticky notes (SPEC-003 to SPEC-035, SPEC-038, SPEC-039).

## Data

| Data | Source |
| --- | --- |
| Header: "My turn N", the number of to-do entries | API-263 |
| Header: the project menu | API-262 |
| Stage tabs and the stage's tool links | API-264 |
| The stage's diagrams, listed above the diagram when there are several (stages 03, 08 and 09) or a removed one is still listed (SPEC-027) | API-264 |
| The diagram or item table: elements by name, layout, AI proposals laid over it, waiting marks, change marks, the confirmation | API-265 |
| The selected thread with its comments | API-266 |
| The workshop board on stage 01 while a workshop is open | API-285 |
| On stage 09, the mockup page in a frame isolated from NEXUS | API-293 |

## Actions

| Action | Operation | Result | Failure |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Move an element (drag, or arrows with Shift for long steps) | API-274 | The element stays where it was put; the document is unchanged (SPEC-012) | Gone from the document → "no longer in the diagram" and a reload |
| Zoom or fit the picture | - | Plus, minus and fit buttons show the current percentage; below 100%, a clearly labelled button returns to 100% for reading; Control-wheel and a pinch begun with two fingers inside the picture zoom around the pointer (SPEC-053). Below 100%, double-click enlarges its point; at 100% or above an element's double-click renames as before, and F2 still renames. At a displayed 10% or less minus approximately halves the scale, and below 10% plus approximately doubles it. Fit scrolls its controls into view before measuring; below 25%, a drag starts at 8 screen pixels and a release inside that distance of its start saves no move. | At the 1% or 200% limit the corresponding button is disabled, and a wheel at the limit, or buttons, double-click and wheel during a drag explain why they cannot zoom; if even 1% cannot fit the whole picture, say "그림이 너무 커서 전체를 한 화면에 담지 못했어요."; if a native pan cannot be stopped, ask to stop scrolling and pinch again; if a redraw or pinch cancels a drag, explain and ask to move it again |
| Undo or redo a move | API-274 | Buttons or Control-Z / Control-Shift-Z restore positions and, when appropriate, automatic placement; the last 50 moves are per diagram and tab (SPEC-055). Inputs keep their own undo; the physical Z key works with non-Latin input, and focus stays on available history controls unless the owner moved it elsewhere. | Write pending → explain the wait without arrow-key scrolling; switching during a reread after a confirmed reset keeps redo and requires a fresh read; a definite non-permission move rejection → cancel that move and explain the reason; after an interrupted write wait for it and reread the diagram before another move, with retry if the read fails; definite rejection → clear history and explain; after a lost answer a successful refresh removes the stale retry and explains the uncertainty, while a failed refresh keeps it; retry and refresh cannot overlap; position changed elsewhere → do not overwrite, reload and explain. |
| Open another diagram listed for the stage | API-265 | That diagram opens and the address gains ?d= with its ID | Gone meanwhile → "This diagram is not in NEXUS" and the stage's first diagram |
| Copy an element | - | "ID name" is on the clipboard and "Copied" shows (SPEC-011) | The browser refuses → the text shows selected to copy by hand |
| Rename (F2, or double click at 100% and above) or connect two elements | API-272 | The element shows the change with a "waiting for reflection" mark (SPEC-021, SPEC-022) | Empty or over 200 characters → the message by the name; to itself → refused; the document changed → stale |
| Comment on the diagram, an element or a row | API-267 | The thread opens in the panel with the comment, waiting on an agent | Over the limit → the message by the box, the text kept |
| Reply in a thread | API-268 | The reply is added in order | Closed meanwhile → "This thread is closed. Start a new comment.", the text kept |
| Close a thread | API-269 | The thread shows closed and leaves both to-dos | Gone → a reload |
| Accept an AI proposal | API-270 | Sent after a 10-second undo period, then the proposal shows as "waiting for reflection" (SPEC-019) | Already decided or the document changed → stale: "ask for a new proposal" |
| Reject an AI proposal | API-271 | Sent after a 10-second undo period, then the overlay is gone and the thread stays open (SPEC-020) | Already decided → stale |
| Cancel a direct edit | API-273 | The diagram shows the element as before (SPEC-023) | Already reflected → stale |
| Confirm the diagram | API-275 | Asked once, then confirms this diagram and assigns recording to the agent. Before confirming, the screen explains the target and that the stage passes when all its diagrams and tables are recorded (SPEC-054) | Waiting changes → the waiting state; the document changed → stale; not drawn → the not-drawn state |
| Cancel the confirmation | API-276 | "Cancelled. It stays in your to-do until you confirm again." | Gone → a reload |
| Open a workshop (stage 01) | API-284 | The workshop state opens with step 0 | One is open already → that one opens |
| Add, move, rename, connect or remove sticky notes (workshop) | API-286, API-287, API-288, API-289, API-290 | The board shows the change at once; the workshop is the source (SPEC-038) | The workshop closed meanwhile → stale |
| Confirm a step (workshop) | API-291 | The step shows confirmed; writing it into the domain document goes to the agent (SPEC-039) | A step without notes → "Add notes before confirming" |
| Import a Miro board (workshop) | API-292 | The notes come in with their text, colour and place (SPEC-041) | The workshop closed → stale |

## States

| State | What the owner sees and can do | From responses |
| --- | --- | --- |
| SCR-145#normal | The workbench: numbered pins on positioned questions open the matching thread; a changed-place tour selects the next existing changed element on the picture; stage tabs under the header; the diagram or item table in the middle with dashed AI proposals and the legend; the work panel on the right with three sections. "This diagram": its state ("not confirmed", "confirmed", "N places changed since the confirmation") with up to four changes and "+N more" to SCR-146, "AI proposals left out are not confirmed", an explanation to answer any questions and review changes, then of the target and the agent recording step, and a button that says it confirms this diagram. "AI proposals": each with its kind, text and reason, and Accept and Reject ("All answered" when none). "Selected": the element's kind, name, its threads and the comment box with AI and owner badges. A never-confirmed diagram says nothing is marked (SPEC-034); a part of the document that cannot be read is left out with its file and line (SPEC-003). By stage: 03 draws each user flow as one diagram of its steps, decisions and labelled arrows, top to bottom as its Mermaid source says (SPEC-006); 08 draws one panel per state of a screen, with the state's name, its description and the responses that lead to it, and a state without a description is an empty panel marked "No description" (SPEC-008); 09 shows the mockup page in a frame isolated from NEXUS, its own links and tabs working inside it, and lists the design tokens it uses in the panel under "This diagram" (SPEC-009). Those stages have one diagram per file, listed above the diagram; choosing one opens it. A removed diagram that has an open thread, a proposed AI proposal or a direct edit waiting for reflection comes last, marked removed, and opens for these only: its threads are read, answered and closed, its proposals show Reject and never Accept, and the "This diagram" section lists its direct edits waiting for reflection in place of the confirm button, each with Cancel edit (on a phone, the list without it); no new comment, move, direct edit, confirm button or Cancel confirmation shows (SPEC-027). A mockup's elements are its tokens, so a token is selected and commented on like any element; on a phone the token list follows the frame. The view reads the page's status before it frames it. A bar above the frame always marks it as a mockup page, and NEXUS never asks for a sign-in inside it, since text typed into the page can leave with a page it opens. When the page opens another page in its frame, the view opens the mockup page again once with "The mockup tried to open another page."; when it does so again, it stops with "The mockup keeps opening other pages" and Open again. A mockup takes no AI proposals: on stage 09 the "AI proposals" section says so, and agents comment on its tokens or on the mockup instead. Every element, a flow's box, a state panel or a token, is selected by keyboard too and shows that it is selected. On a phone: the diagram fills the width and the panel is a sheet under it with confirmation guidance, threads and the comment box; confirmation asks once more; proposal decisions use the undo period; moving, renaming, connecting, cancelling edits and cancelling a confirmation remain on a PC (SPEC-051). External evidence shows its source kind, location, exact original text and time. An unmatched answer from the current conversation cycle, with no later question, shows a bot summary request with its source, exact original and the agent’s decision side by side, and a one-click owner confirmation to close. | API-262#200, API-263#200, API-264#200, API-265#200, API-266#200, API-267#201, API-268#201, API-269#200, API-270#200, API-271#200, API-272#201, API-272#200, API-273#200, API-274#200, API-276#200, API-285#404 (workshop-not-found), API-293#200 |
| SCR-145#loading | The tab row and the panel's section titles stay; the diagram area and the panel's lists are grey shapes in their places, so nothing moves when the data arrives. | - |
| SCR-145#empty | Nothing sent for this stage: "Nothing sent yet." The stage names the material needed and gives the owner words to request it in the AI conversation they use (SPEC-054). An item table with no items: "This stage has no items yet" and the same next-action guidance; if drawing failed or rows were left out, explain the source needs fixing instead; a removed diagram does not ask to send material (SPEC-005, SPEC-054). | API-265#200 |

## Item 240: delayed sending

On PC and phone, a proposal decision or question reply displays “Sends in 10 seconds” and Undo. Undo before sending cancels it; after 10 seconds the page sends the existing API request. Leaving the screen or closing the tab starts the send immediately, including on pagehide. The browser keeps the queued action, including any reply text, in local storage until the server confirms success. On a later visit the page warns about a decision or reply whose send could not be confirmed; a retry uses the same request key. If local storage is unavailable the page refuses to queue the action. Confirmation keeps its result preview and a separate confirmation question. Direct editing remains PC-only, and the confirmation blocks in SPEC-029 do not change.

On a PC the selected element has an “Edit name” button beside its name field, so saving a correction does not require a keyboard shortcut.

On a PC, choosing the next changed element in the tour focuses and selects its name field so that the owner can type and use the visible save button immediately.

# SCR-146 Changes since the last confirmation

[한국어](SCR-146.ko.md)

Path: `/p/{project}/{part}/{stage}/changes`, with the optional query `?d={diagram}`. Flows: FL-002, FL-004, FL-006.

Purpose: The owner sees every element added, removed or changed since the last confirmed version, cancels direct edits that wait for reflection, and confirms (SPEC-023, SPEC-029, SPEC-034).

## Data

| Data | Source |

| Header: "My turn N", the number of to-do entries | API-263 |
| Header: the project menu | API-262 |
| Changes since the last confirmed version: the elements added, removed and changed, named from the current diagram, and the confirmed commit; the direct edits waiting for reflection | API-265 |
| The project's repository, for the link to the confirmed version | API-264 |

## Actions

| Action | Operation | Result | Failure |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cancel a direct edit | API-273 | It leaves the list and the diagram shows the element as before | Already reflected → stale |
| Confirm the diagram | API-275 | The confirmed state, with the way back to the diagram | Waiting changes → the waiting state; the document changed → stale; not drawn → the not-drawn state |
| Back to the diagram | - | SCR-145 opens | None |
